title: Rabbi Ze’ira of Kefar Ramin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Zohar, Shemini 41a. He says that Rabbi Ze’ira had a child named Yose and studied with him three teachings each day and three teachings of wisdom and aggadah each night.

notes.text: The supplied source contains footnote marker [1] after the Zohar locator but omits the footnote’s text. That missing note remains unresolved; the Zohar Shemini 41a occurrence and accompanying names are also unverified in the returned evidence.

The footnote missing from the supplied excerpt is a Wikisource editor’s note pointing to Zohar III 39b. The marker does not appear in the inspected print. Hyman’s printed page 404 gives 41a and calls the boy Yose. At 39b the boy calls himself Yeisa and says that his father, Ze’ira of Kefar Ramin, taught him three Torah teachings by day and three teachings of aggadic wisdom at night. The episode continues at 41a in the consulted folio text.
